# OpenAI primary-runtime PDF capability snapshots

Each directory under `releases/` is an immutable upstream snapshot. The
provenance JSON records the OpenAI distribution URL, version, hashes and MIT
license declaration supplied with the capability. The vendored skill files are
stored as received; ReqPilotX does not modify their text.

- `26.904.11930` is retained for Agent Kit 0.15.2 compatibility.
- `26.905.11957` is the source for new portable ReqPilotX plugin bundles.

Equal file hashes across versions do not merge their release identities.
